# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Scientific-Owner ODQ-104 Approval

Decision identity: `SCI-NOI-ODQ-104`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-08-29`

Status: approved scientific method-definition requirement

## Exact Owner Decision

> **Approve ODQ-104.** Every NOI-GEN method must state explicitly which
> scientifically consequential adjacent reduction state is fixed,
> rerun/relearned, not applicable, or unavailable. A relearned method must
> identify the stages that are rerun/relearned and the resulting state that may
> differ from the real-observation reduction. A generic or partially specified
> “relearned” designation is not sufficient to define an authorized NOI method.
> This is a scientific method-definition requirement, not a requirement for
> exhaustive implementation provenance.

## Sanitized Disposition

Every `NOI-GEN` method shall identify each scientifically consequential
adjacent reduction state and classify it as exactly one of:

- fixed from an exact real-observation reduction or other immutable parent;
- rerun/relearned by the named method;
- not applicable to that method; or
- unavailable, with the resulting method-availability consequence.

A relearned method shall identify the scientifically consequential stages it
reruns or relearns and the resulting state that may differ from the exact
real-observation reduction. Different consequential rerun/relearn graphs define
different scientific methods. A generic `relearned` label, or a label that
omits a scientifically consequential rerun stage or changed state, is
insufficient to authorize the method.

This requirement defines the scientific conditioning question answered by the
method. It does not require exhaustive implementation provenance, tracing of
every internal object or operation, or disclosure of implementation details
that do not affect the scientific method identity.

## Non-Implications

This approval does not:

- select a relearned method or make one numerically available;
- change the ODQ-102A ordinary fixed-state PTC-to-frozen-MAP route;
- authorize mixing fixed-state and relearned members or members from different
  consequential rerun/relearn graphs;
- define exhaustive implementation provenance; or
- resolve source-imprint, UNC, covariance, STD, persistence, filtering, FRUIT,
  profile, conformity, validation, performance, readiness, or production
  questions.
